! About
|-
|
The Consumer Rights Wiki is creating the internet's largest dedicated repository of information on anti-consumer practices, one edit at a time. It documents right-to-repair restrictions, planned obsolescence, subscription traps, dark patterns and digital rights issues.

You don't need an account to read or edit. [[Special:CreateAccount|Creating one]] keeps all your edits under one identity.
